question: Should CodexBar accept sub2api as a permanent built-in provider with dedicated settings, token accounts, CLI, icon, and documentation?
rationale: The implementation follows existing provider architecture, but it adds a substantial new native integration and ongoing maintenance commitment that cannot be inferred from code correctness alone.

options.title: Accept native provider
options.body: Adopt the integration after rebase hygiene, real-runtime proof, and final shared-state review are complete.

options.title: Narrow or decline
options.body: Request a smaller maintenance boundary or decline the built-in provider if ongoing sub2api compatibility is not a repository priority.

recommendation.title: Accept native provider
recommendation.body: Adopt the integration after rebase hygiene, real-runtime proof, and final shared-state review are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the strongest current history across token-account state and recent native provider additions make this the best available decision owner.
